brief:
Settlers assaulted two young men in Beita, a village in the southern Nablus governorate, leaving them injured, Shehab Wire reported. The attack occurred in the northern West Bank community, which has faced repeated incidents of settler violence in recent years.

The identities and ages of the two injured men were not disclosed. The severity of their injuries remained unclear at the time of reporting. Beita has been a flashpoint for clashes between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers, with residents frequently reporting property damage and personal attacks linked to nearby settlement expansion.
